environment.description: Apollo GraphQL server deployed behind an Istio ingress gateway (v1.19) in GKE cluster. The ingress gateway's Gateway resource specifies TLS mode MUTUAL on port 443 with credentialName referencing a Kubernetes secret containing the CA bundle (internal-pki-ca-chain). The DestinationRule for the backend service mesh sidecar enforces ISTIO_MUTUAL between pods. External traffic that does not present a valid client certificate signed by the internal PKI CA is rejected at the TCP handshake level by Envoy before any HTTP/GraphQL payload parsing occurs. The server Pod has no NodePort or hostNetwork exposure; the only ingress path is through the gateway VirtualService bound to the MUTUAL-TLS Gateway. Additionally, a PeerAuthentication policy in STRICT mode is applied namespace-wide, preventing any plaintext connections to the service port even from within the cluster mesh unless the peer has a valid SPIFFE identity issued by the mesh CA.

config.ingress: Istio IngressGateway v1.19, Gateway CR with tls.mode=MUTUAL, credentialName=internal-pki-ca-chain
config.network_policy: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy denies all ingress except from istio-ingressgateway pods on port 4000
config.certificate_ca: Internal PKI CA, certificates issued only to registered service accounts via cert-manager with approval policy
config.pod_exposure: ClusterIP service only, no NodePort, no hostNetwork, no LoadBalancer annotation
